run_chrf_analysis: run the chrf analysis script to compute average chrF scores across language pairs and gender groups
plot_chrf_demo_by_axis: plot chrF scores grouped by bias axis and gender for en-to-xx and xx-to-en translation tasks
plot_chrf_by_lang: plot chrF scores pivoted by language and gender with NLLB language code mapping
aggregate_chrf_by_descriptor_axis: aggregate chrF scores by descriptor axis using the English descriptors lookup table
export_chrf_stats_csv: export chrF statistics DataFrames as CSV files to the nllb chrf results output folder
